author: Good Enough
description:
A landslide can happen with little warning, sending tons of rock, mud, and debris racing downhill at dangerous speeds. Knowing where to move, what areas to avoid, and how to react if the ground suddenly starts shifting can greatly improve your chances of survival.

This Short explains how to survive a landslide, what to do during a mudslide or debris flow, how to avoid being trapped by moving earth, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during a landslide emergency.
title: How to Survive a Deadly Landslide 🏔️⚠️ #landslide #naturaldisaster #survival #survivaltips
